win_system.notes: Cluster wins in expanding rectangular active area; xCluster +1 mult per extra unique cluster from 2nd.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Avalanches after wins/xBomb; xCluster increments win mult from 2nd unique cluster.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: Active rectangle expands via Target, Colossal, and border/corner xBomb explosions.

other.name: xSplit® (samurai swords)
other.how_it_works: 1–2 swords H/V; activate in active area after avalanche; may gain swords/×2; pass mult to split symbols; Scatter/Target/xBomb get ×2 when hit.

other.name: xBomb® Wild
other.how_it_works: Removes up to 10 adjacent (not Bonus); +1 (or split X) to next avalanche mult; border moves active area; corner expands reel+row.

other.name: Target → Wild
other.how_it_works: Expands active area to include Target then becomes Wild.

other.name: Colossal 2×2 / 3×3
other.how_it_works: Expands active area; mult ×2/×3; split rules up to 18 symbols.

scatters.name: Scatter
scatters.behavior: 1/reel; counts only in active area. 3→Dogfight; 4→Tora! Tora! Tora!. Split scatters feed first bonus (X) mult.

multipliers.name: xCluster / xBomb / dial (X)(+)
multipliers.behavior: Cluster and bomb mults in base; cockpit dials in bonus.

base_game_loop.summary: 7×7 cluster with expanding active rectangle, xSplit/xBomb/xCluster/Target/Colossal. Banzai +50%/+100% Scatter odds. 3 Scatter→Dogfight (18 dials); 4→Tora with Midway Pop + Bomb Drop. Cap 41,127×.

phases.name: Optional Banzai xBet
phases.what_happens: +50% one mid Scatter (~3× Dogfight); +100% two Scatters (~10× Tora).

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Clusters in active area after splits/bombs; xCluster mult.

modes.name: Dogfight
modes.retrigger: Any (X) or (+) dial mult resets to 3.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: 18 instrument dials; (X) stay until (+) lands; end converts leftover (X)→(+).
modes.progressive_state: Round mult from sum(+) × product(X). Dogfight Attack on full column.

phases.name: Cockpit
phases.what_happens: Spin dials; apply (+) then (X) to round mult.

modes.name: TORA! TORA! TORA!
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Dogfight rules + Midway Pop (mid-row mult pops to top) + Bomb Drop (full row → ship bomb; hit converts).

features.name: xBet® Banzai! +100%
features.effects: Two Scatters on drop; ~10× Tora chance.

feature_buy.notes: CMS documents Banzai ante-style bets; no separate FS buy prices printed.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt: 7×7 cluster; expanding active area; xSplit swords; xBomb; xCluster; Target/Colossal; 3 Scatter Dogfight / 4 Tora; Banzai xBet +50%/+100%; max 41,127×.

unknowns: exact Dogfight Attack / Bomb Drop hit tables
